app.name: Stratum
app.description: Supplier and food safety document control

topbar.previewHint: Sample-data preview: switch person or role to see what each user sees.

sample.hint: These companies, suppliers and documents are fictional. None of this data belongs to a real customer.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.description: What needs a decision today: expirations, documents to review and pending suppliers.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Manufacturers and distributors, their ingredients and the status of their file.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Certificates and documents to review, current, expiring and missing.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Documents requested from suppliers, with their reminders and due dates.

history.title: History
history.description: Who did what, when and why, on every supplier and document.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company details, users, roles and the document catalog.

empty.buildingTitle: This section is being built in the coming weeks
empty.buildingBody: For now the app frame is ready: navigation, languages and design. The real screens arrive with the sample data.

home.title: Choose a company
home.description: Each company has its own space. Your data never mixes with another company's.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: We couldn't show this page. Please try again. If the problem continues, email soporte@stratumpr.com with this code.
errors.notFoundBody: The address doesn't exist or is no longer available.

review.title: Component review
review.description: Every piece of the design system, to approve the look before building real screens.
review.bodySample: Stratum keeps every supplier's certificates current, requests the missing ones and warns you before they expire.

noAccess.title: Your role does not have access to this section
noAccess.body: If you need it, ask an administrator at your company to change your role.

suppliers.count: {shown, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}} of {total}
suppliers.caption: Suppliers, their approval and requirements
suppliers.emptyBody: Try another name or clear the filters.
suppliers.expiringFilter: Only with something expiring in 30 days
suppliers.requirementsHint: Requirements: current out of those that apply to what is bought today. Waived and not-applicable ones aren't counted. Active materials means they're bought, not that they're approved.

approval.title: Approval
approval.hint: The system warns, but the decision is yours. Every decision is recorded with who, when and why.

warnings.missing_documents: {count, plural, one {# document is missing or expired.} other {# documents are missing or expired.}} A conditional approval may be more appropriate.
warnings.nonconformities: {count} nonconformities in the last 12 months. Check whether it should stay approved; the decision is yours.
warnings.conditions_overdue: The conditions were due for review on {date}.
warnings.blocking: {count, plural, one {A blocking requirement isn't met.} other {# blocking requirements aren't met.}} Full approval waits for them.
warnings.review_overdue: The approval was due for review on {date}.

actionHints.approve: On the approved supplier list, with its next review.
actionHints.approve_conditional: Approved while it meets the conditions, with a review date.
actionHints.suspend: Nothing is bought from it until it's approved again.
actionHints.deactivate: Nothing is bought from it anymore. Its history is kept.
actionHints.reactivate: It goes back to the stage it was in.
actionHints.reject: Not approved and not bought from. It stays in the history; to reconsider, reactivate and start over.

approval.reasonHint: It's kept in the approval history.
approval.conditionsHint: What the supplier must do, for example send its current GFSI certificate.
approval.reviewByHint: The next review of the approval, within 3 years.

errors.not_available: That decision is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.date_too_far: Must be within the next 12 months.
errors.blocked: Blocking requirements aren't met. Approve with conditions or wait until they are.
errors.after_review: Must be before the review date.

denial.no_permission: Your role can see the supplier's status but can't approve it.
denial.own_supplier: You added this supplier and your company requires someone else to approve it.

approval.blockedHint: {count, plural, one {A blocking requirement is missing or not accepted.} other {# blocking requirements are missing or not accepted.}} Only a conditional approval is possible.
approval.reviewByHintConditional: When the conditions are reviewed, within 12 months.
approval.scopeHint: If you tick none, it covers everything bought from them.

restrictions.coa_every_lot: Request and check the COA for every lot
restrictions.no_new_materials: No new materials while it lasts

panel.attentionHint: Expired and expiring in the next 30 days.
panel.attentionEmpty: Nothing expires in the next 30 days.
panel.inDays: {days, plural, =0 {expires today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
panel.daysAgo: {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

supplier.notFoundBody: It may no longer exist, or the address is incomplete.
supplier.partyDocsHint: What this supplier is asked for, based on its role and origin.
supplier.materialsHint: Each material bought from them, from which facility, whether it's bought today and its food-safety approval, separately.
supplier.noMaterials: This supplier has no approved materials.
supplier.notEvaluated: Not evaluated: this material is not being bought now.

risk.title: Supplier risk
risk.hint: Assessed by a person: the factors suggest, but the rating and the reason are theirs.
risk.none: Not assessed. Nobody has assessed this supplier's risk yet.
risk.materialNote: Each material's own risk is shown separately, under Materials.

supplier.documentsHint: Everything received, including documents waiting for review and per-lot certificates of analysis.
supplier.noDocuments: No documents from this supplier yet.

matrix.title: Documents by material
matrix.hint: Each material bought from this supplier and the status of its documents. Tap a cell to see the document or upload it.
matrix.captionMaterial: Materials in rows and documents in columns
matrix.captionDocument: Documents in rows and materials in columns
matrix.allComplete: Every document for these materials is current.
matrix.none: Nothing is bought from this supplier right now.
matrix.inactive: {count, plural, one {# material offered} other {# materials offered}} but not bought now: no documents are required until the first order.

overview.contactsHint: Their language sets the language of emails and requests.
overview.blockingHint: Requirements the company marked as blocking. While they're missing, only a conditional approval is possible.

fsma.title: FSMA 204 (traceability)
fsma.hint: Whether the traceability rule applies to what this supplier sends. A person decides, with a reason.

hints.ftl_materials: Per the materials, something bought from them is on the Food Traceability List.
hints.no_ftl_materials: Per the materials, nothing bought from them is on the Food Traceability List.
hints.materials_not_checked: Some materials haven't been checked against the Food Traceability List.

fsma.later: Lot-level capture (CTEs and KDEs) comes in a later phase; there's no readiness score here.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.hint: The supplier's plants and warehouses. Certificates belong to each facility: one plant's doesn't cover another.
facilities.legacy: created from the supplier's previous location
facilities.directoryChecked: Confirmed in the scheme's directory; accepted {date}
facilities.pdfOnly: There's a certificate, but nobody has recorded its details or confirmed it in the scheme's directory. A PDF alone doesn't certify the supplier.
facilities.nothingBought: Nothing is bought from this facility now, so it has no requirements.

documentsTab.summary: {pending, plural, =0 {Nothing to review} one {# document to review} other {# documents to review}} · {open, plural, =0 {no open requirements} one {# open requirement} other {# open requirements}}.
documentsTab.requirementsHint: What's asked, for which facility or material, why it applies and under which program. Only reviewed and accepted evidence counts.

history.title: History
history.hint: Everything recorded about this supplier, newest first. Nothing is edited or deleted.
history.auditNote: With sample data this history lives in memory. The chained audit log (each entry holding the previous one's hash) comes with the database.

documents.caption: Documents
documents.queueHint: Oldest first. Accepting or rejecting each one updates compliance right away.
documents.emptyQueueBody: When a supplier or your team uploads a document, it shows up here for review.

document.notFoundBody: It may no longer exist, or the address is incomplete.
document.expiresNever: Does not expire: tracked by lot
document.filePending: This sample document has no file. The ones you upload will show here.

review.title: Review
review.reasonHint: Required to reject. Whoever sends the replacement will see it.
review.acceptHint: Once accepted it counts toward compliance and replaces the previous one of the same type.
review.doneAcceptSuperseded: Document accepted. It replaced {count, plural, one {# older document} other {# older documents}}.

denial.own_upload: You uploaded this document. Someone else on your team must review it.
denial.no_permission: Your role can't accept or reject documents.
denial.not_pending: This document has already been reviewed.
denial.reason_required: Write the reason for rejecting (at least 5 characters).
denial.reason_too_long: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).
denial.invalid: We couldn't process the request. Please try again.

history.title: History of this document
history.hint: Every version received. Accepting a new one marks the previous one as superseded; none is ever deleted.
history.caption: Document versions
history.only: This is the only version received.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.description: The document goes to the “To review” list, and someone else on your team reviews it.
upload.lotHint: The lot number shown on the certificate.
upload.issuedHint: Optional, but it helps calculate the expiration.
upload.expiresHint: Only if it's printed on the document. Otherwise it's calculated: {months} months from issue.
upload.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
upload.noAccessBody: If you need to, ask an administrator at your company to change your role.

errors.type_not_for_subject: That type doesn't apply to what's chosen under “For”.
errors.future_date: The date can't be in the future.
errors.expires_before_issued: Must be after the issue date.
errors.file_type: Only PDF, JPG or PNG. The file's content is checked, not just its name.

nonconformities.title: Nonconformities
nonconformities.hint: Problems with what the supplier delivered or did. Three in 12 months trigger a warning.
nonconformities.caption: Supplier nonconformities
nonconformities.descriptionHint: What happened, with which delivery or lot.

errors.future_date: The date can't be in the future.

nonconformities.capaLater: Full follow-up (root cause, corrective actions and verification) comes with the findings and CAPA module.

requirements.none: No requirements: nothing is bought from them now
requirements.blocking: {count, plural, one {# blocks approval} other {# block approval}}

nextAction.blocking_gap: {count, plural, one {Resolve the blocking requirement} other {Resolve # blocking requirements}}
nextAction.review_document: {count, plural, one {Review the document received} other {Review # documents received}}
nextAction.open_issue: {count, plural, one {Handle the open nonconformity} other {Handle # open nonconformities}}
nextAction.gap: {count, plural, one {Request the missing requirement} other {Request # open requirements}}
nextAction.expiring: {count, plural, one {Renew the one expiring soon} other {Renew # expiring soon}}
